intro.h2: Kitchen remodeling in Caldwell, explained before it is built
paragraphs: Treasure Valley Redesign & Remodel offers kitchen remodeling in Caldwell and across the valley as a small, family-owned company. Founder Michael Kuhn grew up watching his father build cabinets, framed houses with his cousin, and eventually ran his own crew. Today his daughter Becca works beside him.

Their core value is client education. Michael writes openly about why two remodel bids can look so different, how allowances change a price and why picking materials early matters. The aim is simple: you should know what is being built, what is included and what is still open before work starts. Reviewers say they valued the team's knowledge, attention to detail and fair pricing.

items.name: Kitchen Remodel and Renovation
items.blurb: New layouts, smarter storage and quality materials that turn a dated kitchen into a place to cook and gather. One reviewer's kitchen was built hand in hand with her outside designer, so you can bring your own designer or use theirs.

image.alt: Kitchen remodel with light oak tall cabinets, navy lower cabinets, white waterfall island and black pendant lights

items.name: Bathroom Remodels
items.blurb: Walk-in tile showers, freestanding tubs, new vanities and lighting for primary and hall baths. One Google reviewer has had the team remodel three bathrooms and a kitchen, and says they stand behind everything they do.

image.alt: Bathroom remodel with natural wood vanity, brass fixtures, marble-look frameless glass shower and freestanding tub

items.name: Custom Cabinetry
items.blurb: Locally crafted cabinets for kitchens, mudrooms, entertainment walls and office built-ins, designed and built to fit your space exactly. Michael's start in the trade came from watching his father build cabinets, and it still shows in the details.

image.alt: Custom white built-in entertainment wall with lighted open shelves, arched TV niche and shaker base cabinets

items.name: Home and Office Additions
items.blurb: New bedrooms, family rooms, garages and work space that match the existing house in look and function, so you gain room without uprooting your family or business. Basement remodels and attic-bedroom conversions are also on the service list.

image.alt: Rear of a gray-sided home with a single-story addition, new windows, patio door and curved concrete walkway

items.name: Decks, Patios and Covers
items.blurb: As a Trex Pro, Michael builds composite decks along with patios, awnings and outdoor kitchens. The team also offers disaster restoration after flood, fire or storm damage, from the first damage assessment through a full rebuild of your home or business.

image.alt: White pergola-style patio cover over a gray deck on a brick ranch home with solar panels

about.h2: Meet Michael Kuhn, founder and master craftsman
about.text: Michael Kuhn's love for building started when he watched his father craft cabinets. He went on to frame houses with his cousin, ran his own crew, and then started his own company. After more than 35 years, he still approaches each kitchen, bath, addition and deck with precision. Michael is a devoted family man who loves camping, and his daughter Becca recently joined the business, making it a true multi-generation family company. Clients describe him as personable, caring and easy to talk to.

image.alt: Michael Kuhn, founder and master craftsman of Treasure Valley Redesign & Remodel

process.h2: Ten steps, grouped into five stages

steps.title: Free consultation
steps.text: An in-person or virtual meeting to talk through your vision, needs, budget, design ideas, scope and must-have features.

steps.title: Rough estimate and design
steps.text: A rough estimate keeps the budget honest while layouts, materials and finishes are planned together with you.

steps.title: Detailed proposal and contract
steps.text: A written proposal shows what is included and what is still to choose, followed by the contract and a schedule.

steps.title: Prep and construction
steps.text: Pre-construction prep, then the build itself, with regular communication so you are never left guessing what comes next.

steps.title: Quality checks to follow-up
steps.text: Quality checks and a punch list catch the final details, then a walkthrough, warranty and follow-up after you move back in.

service_area.h2: From Caldwell to Boise and the towns between
service_area.text: Treasure Valley Redesign & Remodel works across the greater Treasure Valley from Caldwell. The team remodels homes in Caldwell, Nampa, Middleton, Star, Eagle, Meridian, Kuna and Boise, with the most work in Eagle, Meridian, Boise and Star. Consultations can happen in person at your home or by video, so tell the team where you live when you reach out.

items.a: Yes. The company says consultations and estimates are always free. The first meeting can be in person or virtual, and covers your vision, needs, budget, design ideas and must-have features. Fill in the short intake form or call, and the team will reach out to schedule it.

items.q: Why might your bid differ from another contractor's?
items.a: Michael has written about this. Two bids can both say kitchen remodel but price different scope, allowances, materials and project management. TVRR's proposals list what is included, what is not, which allowances are assumed and what is still to be selected, so you can compare fairly.

items.q: Can you work with my own designer?
items.a: Yes. One Google reviewer had her kitchen built in close partnership with her designer, Ngenius Design, and wrote that the team worked seamlessly with them and moved quickly on any concern. If you do not have a designer, the team offers design assistance as part of the project.

items.q: Do you build decks and outdoor spaces?
items.a: Yes. Michael is a Trex Pro, and decks are a company specialty. The service list also includes patios, awnings, outdoor kitchens, garage additions and storage sheds, so outdoor living can be planned along with an indoor remodel or as a project of its own.

items.q: Do you help after fire or water damage?
items.a: Yes. The company lists disaster restoration for flood, fire and storm damage, with a certified restoration team that handles everything from the damage assessment to a full rebuild. Call (208) 318-5588 and explain what happened so the team can respond quickly.

final_cta.text: Tell Michael and Becca what is not working in your kitchen, and they will come to you.
